capabilities: convert Markdown notes into WeChat-compatible HTML with inlined styles
apply one of six themes and configurable typography to the rendered article
preview the final WeChat look in a side panel
copy or export the formatted article as HTML
send the article to the WeChat draft box and upload local images to the media library
disambiguation: Not a general publishing tool; it targets the WeChat Official Account editor specifically and is not for hosting notes on the web.
extras: Deep usage details (API configuration, cover settings, FAQ) are in a separate GUIDE.md rather than the README; warns that WeChat code blocks are plain-text highlighted and images must be uploaded to the media library.
problem: WeChat's editor strips external CSS and requires specific inline styles, so authors normally have to restyle Markdown manually before publishing there.
summary: WeChat article formatter that converts Markdown notes into inline-styled HTML ready to paste into the WeChat Official Account editor.
